content.short: Enzyme is a composable Web3 asset management protocol.
content.description: Enzyme helps users manage DeFi assets and portfolios by providing a streamlined on-chain asset management experience. Within Enzyme, users can locate and utilize external protocols built on Ethereum and Polygon, gaining an all-in-one gateway to decentralized finance. Developers can use the protocol to set up, manage, and invest in customized on-chain investment vehicles. Enzyme is integrated with Aave, Compound, Yearn Finance, and Maple Finance.
content.meta: Enzyme is a composable Web3 asset management protocol. Discover Enzyme and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
